title: Ethlete Component Generator
description: Scaffolds a component domain that follows the three-tier architecture: folder layout, headless + default split, imports barrel, styles, spec, stories, docs page and barrel/sidebar wiring.

tier.description: Which tiers to scaffold: 'both' is a headless directive plus the default component applying it, 'component' a presentational component only, 'headless' a behavior directive only.

x-prompt.message: Which tiers does the domain need?

category.description: Storybook category the story sits under, below 'Components'. Also decides the story id prefix used by the docs page's <StoryEmbed>.

x-prompt.message: Which Storybook category does the domain belong to?

items.label: Actions - buttons and the things you press
Data display - showing values and records
Forms - controls that carry a value
Overlays - things that float above the page

project.description: Nx project to scaffold into. The domain lands in its '<sourceRoot>/lib/<name>'.

errors.description: Add a '<name>-errors.ts' with the next free 100-code block.

stories.description: Add a Storybook story and its demo component.

docs.description: Add a VitePress guide page and its sidebar entry.

docsGroup.description: Sidebar group the guide page is listed under.

docsRoot.description: Path to the VitePress site (relative to workspace root).
